text:
Maya: Heads-up — opened a PR to add an "Effective Quota" dashboard panel + updated SDK snippet for the metering->pricing migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

Liam: Can you paste the minimal Grafana panel JSON here so I can import and tweak thresholds quickly?

Maya: Pushing a tiny example into the PR, but quick copy for testing:

```json
{
  \"title\": \"Effective Quota Usage\",
  \"type\": \"timeseries\",
  \"targets\": [{\"expr\": \"sum(rate(metering_effective_quota_used[5m])) by (tier)\"}],
  \"fieldConfig\": {\"defaults\": {\"unit\": \"short\"}},
  \"thresholds\": {\"mode\": \"absolute\", \"steps\": [{\"value\": null, \"color\": \"green\"}, {\"value\": 0.8, \"color\": \"orange\"}, {\"value\": 0.95, \"color\": \"red\"}] }
}
```

Sophia: This is great. Please call out in the migration guide that `effective_quota` = base_quota + burst_credits - grace_deductions and show a quick numeric example so customers understand thresholds.

Rahul: Also add short SDK examples for reading the new fields. Suggestion for python + curl in the docs: 

```python
# python example (v2 SDK)
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.v2.usage.get_effective_quota(tenant_id=\"acct_123\")
print(resp['effective_quota'], resp.get('burst_remaining'))
```

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/usage/effective_quota?tenant=acct_123

Maya: I'll add both. Plan: deprecate old `quota` field in ~2 months, compatibility shim in SDK for one release, and clear migration notes.

Liam: Can you also put panel_id and import JSON link into the PR description so eng-sre can import? And include a suggested alert rule: `effective_quota_used / effective_quota > 0.9 for 5m` with a note about burst credit exhaustion.

Maya: Added panel import JSON and sample alert rule to PR description. DocsBot: please run link-checker on the branch.

DocsBot: link-checker: 1 broken anchor detected in migration guide -> `#quota-migration-legacy`. Suggestion: update to `#legacy-quota-mapping` :mag:

Sophia: I'll fix the anchor and add a short mapping table showing `quota` -> `effective_quota` + example tenant numbers (base 100k, burst 20k, grace -5k => effective 115k).

Rahul: Also a quick note — use `client.v2` in snippets. Older `client` examples caused confusion in previous PR.

Maya: Good catch, switching all snippets to v2 and adding one-line compatibility note. Next steps assigned: Sophia (anchor + mapping table), Liam (alerts + import tests), Rahul (SDK snippet review). I'll wait for checks and merge once green. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Liam: ack

Sophia: on it

Rahul: will review tonight

Maya: If all checks pass I'll merge tomorrow morning and follow up with a short note in the changelog.
